title: 집들이에 가요: 손님이 알아야 할 낱말
objective: By the end, you can use ten words about visiting a home (invite, visit, guest, greeting, gift and more) in short Korean sentences.
summary: This worksheet teaches ten everyday words for visiting someone's home in Korea, such as for a housewarming party.

task.title: Use the visit words
task.line: Use the ten words from page 1 to choose, fill in, or put the words in order.

words.meaning: to visit (a person or place, a little formal)
words.exampleMeaning: We are visiting our teacher's home next week.

words.meaning: guest (someone who comes to your home)

words.exampleMeaning: On Saturday I'm going to Minsu's housewarming party.
What should we buy as a housewarming gift?
My friend invited me to a birthday party.
Last month I moved near my office.
Please take off your shoes here.

words.meaning: toilet paper, tissue (a common housewarming gift)
words.example: 집들이에 휴지를 사 가는 사람이 많아요.
words.exampleMeaning: Many people bring toilet paper to a housewarming.
Please text me your home address.

exercises: Choose the right word: ① 이번 주말에 동료들을 우리 집에 (초대해요 / 방문해요). ② 손님, 여기에서 구두를 (벗으세요 / 이사하세요). ③ 다음 달에 부산에 가서 친구 집을 (방문해요 / 초대해요).
Fill in the blank (use 이사하다): 지난달에 새 집으로 ____.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 할머니 댁에 가면 먼저 할머니께 ____를 해요.
Fill in the blank with one word from the list: 토요일에 친구 다섯 명이 우리 집에 와요. 저는 ____ 다섯 명을 기다려요.
Fill in both blanks with words from the list: 화장실에 ____가 없어요. 그리고 친구 생일 ____도 사야 해요.
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 몰라요 / 주소를 / 아직 / 친구 집
answers: ① 초대해요 ② 벗으세요 ③ 방문해요
아직 친구 집 주소를 몰라요. (친구 집 주소를 아직 몰라요.)
